reconcile.note: Gill limits Mark's exorcism sign to a temporary, evidentiary gift rather than proof of salvation, leaving room for outside believers and false professors alike.

discrepancy.emptyNote: Steve Wells's Skeptic's Annotated Bible lists Mark's promise that exorcism marks believers alongside an unaffiliated exorcist and Jesus's rejected workers as incompatible.

sides.snippet: Then I will tell them, 'I never knew you. Depart from me, you who work iniquity.'
sides.verseText: Then I will tell them, 'I never knew you. Depart from me, you who work iniquity.'

sides.snippet: These signs will accompany those who believe: in my name they will cast out demons
sides.verseText: These signs will accompany those who believe: in my name they will cast out demons; they will speak with new languages;
